scope: Pure .NET interaction continuity; no game, rendering or native input

results.name: water relieves thirst without filling the stomach or healing an injured foot
satisfied drinking refuses another cup without farming trust
sweet food preserves its own intake type and consumes one portion
closing the mouth or pausing before acceptance consumes nothing
passive thirst freezes in close-up while a started mouthful may finish
thirsty immobilized oil can ask for water without pretending it can walk
save rejects invalid hydration and intake types at its actual entry
older saves acquire safe hydration defaults and keep an existing mouthful
accepted food stays consumed after swallowing while the same mouse gesture is held
a completed held meal sweet or drink releases needs after its actual swallowing response
results.error: Drink/water: holding the finished tool trapped the oil or skipped swallowing

results.name: returning an unaccepted offer waits for pending and accepted autonomous bites without stealing their source
completed care keeps its short response then releases food water and rest without repeated medicine
completed or already intact repair releases movement without repeating repairs
releasing or cancelling completed repair clears only its own body response
completed nursing does not replay treatment or erase a newer painful response
continuing to wipe a clean cheek cannot farm affection after the first dirt was removed
wiping an already clean accessory does not invent another meaningful repair event
completing repair records one completion and a new tear resets work but not history
repair work cannot be negative in a persisted world
a single mouse jump cannot turn a gentle stroke into recorded rough handling
one delayed input frame cannot stand in for sustained fast rubbing
repeating pain care does not restart an already running foot recovery delay
a rest invitation does not display sleep while walking to a distant cushion
rest command alone grants no cushioned healing bonus on a bare floor
an explicit hurtful interruption wakes the oil and ends the rest action
a rest invitation cancels an unfinished exercise without crediting a lesson
accepting a new exercise stops the current rest instead of sleeping through practice
an autonomous invitation supplies the same body pose used by the renderer
releasing an accepted meal keeps chewing while releasing pressure stops deformation
a release-triggered push keeps its recoil instead of immediately returning an idle pose
save files do not replay an expired held gesture as an active reaction on load
dressing records actual completed care at its body part and cannot appear on a cancelled attempt
an injured treated foot keeps its dressing after the initial settling time
voice intent follows the oil's actual response instead of the last selected tool group
one mouse jump during gentle rocking is a slow-down cue rather than abusive handling
sustained harsh rocking prompts refusal while leaving the physical support in place
teasing can move food off the body surface and a real withdrawal changes future food trust once
holding bait in reach without pulling it away does not continuously invent disappointed experiences
wiping the left cheek leaves the right cheek dirty and makes only the left cheek wet
drying one side preserves the opposite wet patch and whole-body soiling still reaches both
moving care to the opposite cheek restarts the actual treatment dwell and dresses that side
switching cheeks requires a fresh nuzzle invitation instead of reusing contact on the other side
inspection reports a remaining local wet patch even when the body average is low
partial face drying does not claim that the feet or the whole body are already dry
a frightened oil can refuse wiping without becoming visibly pleased or losing the dirt
local touch sensitivity can receive matching care even after general health recovers
turning a hat-wearing oil or placing its frame reserves the changed silhouette
ground turning actions do not change posture in midair
lifting or righting an oil ends its special upside-down drying period
rigid fixtures cannot be assembled through a resting cushion
resuming a low carry keeps its existing height instead of lifting it again
a height concern follows an actual rise and easing down changes the response without healing or dropping
an invitation to sing or stretch waits for the accepted mouthful to finish
hanging height controls use the actual body-size limits and reverse immediately at an endpoint
inspection and settled expression still expose a sore head or cheek after general pain has faded
a thirsty but otherwise healthy oil can explain thirst when inspected
care at a second site preserves the first site's dressing and both cheek sides
new bottom damage invalidates only the old bottom treatment without resurrecting it next tick
each dressing freezes in close-up and expires only after its site has settled
save validation rejects duplicate and invalid per-site dressing data
one roll sample cannot teleport across the room or catch up a long frame
a roll blocked at the room edge causes no stationary dirt or distress
starting a roll reserves turning room before it can overlap a neighbor
roll orientation follows signed actual travel and freezes without contact or motion
rolling a turned oil interrupts drying and never serializes a held input pose
short contact keeps its actual response direction even when physical support prevents displacement
a sore cheek can refuse rubbing while the other side remains available
care must reach the sore cheek and cannot treat it through the healthy side
old cheek sensitivity imports without healing either side and local sides survive saving
aiming holds the selected ball and releases only that exact object
removing or hiding the held ball cannot redirect the release to another ball
a turned oil cannot kick the ball while it cannot orient itself to play
a fast soft ball rebounds from the body with a brief reaction and no injury
ball collisions respect box walls and the visible yard fence instead of an inner invisible rectangle
a ball must be placed in clear space and a cushion absorbs its approach
woodland balls rebound from the visible trunk section and cannot be placed inside trees
a rolling ball enters the river slows and floats instead of bouncing at an invisible bank
river current freezes in pause and does not start passive drift in close-up
small presentation steps do not erase gentle river drift
oil observes a floating ball without repeatedly chasing it into the river
a floating ball can be pushed back toward shore without moving the oil into water
practiced ball play returns closer to the player than a beginner's attempt
a finished mouthful acknowledges swallowing once without another portion or passive recovery
finishing a mouthful does not replace a newer pain response with cheerful speech
releasing the empty spoon does not erase the newer swallowing response
conversation waits for swallowing without early affection or repeated invitations
a newer painful interaction cancels a waiting conversation
timely praise keeps its event while swallowing without rewarding the same event twice
resting oil replies gently without waking or granting passive recovery in close-up
pause freezes queued conversation and save cannot replay it as a reward
verbal comfort refusal describes distance without inventing physical touch
a stored treasure returns as the same object without farming a fresh gift
treasure placement clears a turned body and stays in its current region
stored treasure keeps ownership through save and cannot be displayed as present
rapid harsh speech shares a response interval instead of rewriting the relationship on every click
scolding interrupts a lesson without recording learning or a completed rule
a contextual scold requires a current observed unresolved incident for this oil
immobility and a real unanswered request have distinct harsh speech feedback
belittling can provoke resistance or hurt without turning either into affection
moving the holding hand away releases only the hand restraint and contact can resume
push release off the body cannot apply saved force or a reentry pointer jump
an off-contact pressed mouse does not freeze the oil's own movement or keep deforming it
following can reach the rear yard without an invisible inner movement boundary
food in another region cannot be eaten through matching coordinates
wait practice and placed meals use actual food in the active region
changing active region during a gesture still cleans up the original oil's transient hold

saving during supported lowering preserves support without replaying its transient motion
taking manual control of supported lowering does not keep moving or drop on cancellation
fixed-seed mixed gestures keep saves valid and leave no ghost hands across cancellation and pause
